data.name: Project Klorp
data.detailed_description:
Lead an Expedition Into the Unknown

Project Klorp is a spaceflight sandbox about exploring an unfamiliar solar system, building vehicles, and establishing a new home for a colony of Klorps.

Design rockets, aircraft, and other craft from individual parts. Pilot your creations through atmospheres and space, travel between worlds, and discover what the solar system has to offer.

Build and Pilot Your Own Vehicles

Build aircraft to explore nearby regions, rockets capable of reaching orbit, landers for distant moons, and specialized vehicles for whatever challenges you encounter.

Test your designs, discover their flaws, rebuild them, and try again.

Explore a Solar System

Exploration drives your expedition forward. Travel to new destinations, complete missions, and uncover resources and knowledge that allow you to develop new technology, expand your colony, and reach farther into the solar system.

Each successful expedition opens new possibilities, creating a continuous cycle of building, launching, exploring, and preparing for the next journey.

Gather Resources and Advance Your Technology

Exploration provides the resources and discoveries needed to move your expedition forward.

Complete missions, explore new locations, and gather materials to unlock new technologies. Use what you discover to construct more capable vehicles, travel farther into the system, and expand what your colony can accomplish.

Grow Your Colony

Develop your settlement as the expedition pushes farther into the unknown.

Complete community missions, gather the resources your Klorps need, and help a small outpost grow into a thriving new home for Klorpkind.

Explore Your Way

Follow missions and technological progression, focus on growing your colony, or experiment freely with your own designs.

Whether you are carefully planning an interplanetary expedition or determining how many engines can be attached to one small vehicle, Project Klorp is built around experimentation, discovery, and the satisfaction of making something that finally works.

Features

  • Build rockets, aircraft, landers, rovers, and other vehicles from individual parts

  • Pilot your creations through physics-driven atmospheric and spaceflight

  • Explore planets, moons, and other destinations across an unfamiliar solar system

  • Complete missions and gather resources

  • Unlock new parts and technologies

  • Establish and grow a colony

  • Experiment freely in an open-ended single-player sandbox

data.short_description: Lead an expedition into an unexplored solar system. Build rockets, aircraft, and other vehicles, discover new worlds, gather resources, complete missions, unlock technology, and grow a colony of tiny purple Klorps in this spaceflight sandbox.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
